text:
maria: Quick note from today's design review — we don't have a firm call on where in-product help links should point. Some folks prefer the overlay modal for quick tips, others want the docs panel (right rail) for deeper cross-links and search. Thoughts?

tyler: From design POV: overlay = faster, less context switching; panel = better for cross-linking and discoverability. Concern: overlays become stale if docs change.

anika: Docs team prefers the panel. It's easier to maintain canonical content, supports anchors to API examples/evals, and gives us page view metrics.

kevin: DevEx: panel is also better for keyboard navigation and accessibility — modals trap focus and can be annoying for power users. Panel can be collapsed and doesn't interrupt the user flow.

maria: We also have a terminology mismatch. Docs use "model variant" but console currently shows "version" in the deploy flow. That confuses customers during onboarding.

anika: Agree — propose we standardize on "model variant" across UI and docs. That's what our model ops docs and onboarding guides use.

tyler: UX nit: panel header should include a small breadcrumb + a clear "Open in docs" (external) link. That signals the panel is a subset of canonical docs.

maria: What about contextual microtips like "long-running inference increases cost" — tooltip vs overlay vs panel?

kevin: Rule of thumb suggestion: tooltips for microcopy (one-liners), overlay for short walkthroughs or error remediation, and panel for reference + examples + links.

sre-bot: deploy: help-panel v2 rolled to staging at 2025-03-10T14:22Z

anika: Copy suggestion: change "Dedicated" label in the UI to "Reserved capacity" to match contract language and docs. Also update cross-link anchors to use `#reserved-capacity` (example: `/docs/serving#reserved-capacity`).

tyler: Accessibility: if we go with right-rail panel, ensure skip links exist ("Skip to main"), set `aria-labelledby` on the panel heading, and move focus to the first interactive element inside the panel when opened.

maria: Action items (from this thread):
  1) Docs: standardize term to "model variant" and add redirects for old wording (owner: anika)
  2) Product UI: change label "Dedicated" -> "Reserved capacity" (owner: kevin)
  3) Design: update panel header mock to include breadcrumb + "Open in docs" link and accessibility checklist (owner: tyler)
  4) DevEx/platform: emit analytics event `help.opened` with property `source: overlay|panel|tooltip` (owner: kevin)

kevin: I'll file the PR for the UI label + analytics event. ETA: end of sprint. Ticket: PLAT-521.

anika: I'll update docs and add stable anchors and redirects. ETA: 2 business days.

tyler: I'll upload updated mocks and the accessibility checklist into the design folder and link to the panel spec.

maria: Also — ensure in-product search surfaces docs anchors (we currently only show top-level pages) so panel search works.

kevin: Noted — adding platform search ticket PLAT-523 and will follow up with infra.

maria: OK closing this thread for now. We'll review final copy and the panel accessibility checklist in the next design review. :white_check_mark:

maria: TL;DR — panel wins for canonical docs and cross-links; overlay/tooltips used for micro-interactions. Next: standardize terminology and update labels/copy across product + docs.
